## Ready Capital Corporation Announces One-For-Ten Reverse Stock Split


11/23/2026


Download the PDF version PDF Format (opens in new window)


NEW YORK, Nov. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Ready Capital Corporation (“Ready Capital” or the “Company”) (NYSE: RC) today announced that its Board of Directors (the “Board”) has approved a reverse stock split of Ready Capital’s outstanding shares of common stock at a ratio of one-for-ten (the “Reverse Stock Split”).


**One-for-Ten Reverse Stock Split**


The Reverse Stock Split is scheduled to take effect at 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time on December 7, 2026 (the "Effective Time"). At the Effective Time, every ten issued and outstanding shares of common stock of the Company will be combined into one share of common stock of the Company. The Board also approved a reduction of the Company’s authorized shares of common stock from 500,000,000 to 50,000,000, effective immediately following the Effective Time. Following the Reverse Stock Split, the Company will file articles of amendment so the par value of the common stock will remain $0.0001 per share. Trading in Ready Capital’s common stock on a split-adjusted basis is expected to begin at the market open on December 8, 2026. Ready Capital’s common stock will continue trading on the New York Stock Exchange (“NYSE”) under the symbol "RC" but will be under a new CUSIP number: 75574U820.


As a result of the Reverse Stock Split, the number of outstanding shares of Ready Capital’s common stock as of November 23, 2026, will be reduced from approximately 159,105,053 to approximately 15,910,505. The conversion rate of Ready Capital’s 6.25% Series C Cumulative Convertible Preferred Stock and the change of control share cap of its 6.50% Series E Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock will be adjusted proportionately in accordance with their terms. The Reverse Stock Split does not affect the number of outstanding shares of either series, or their liquidation preferences or dividend rates.


No fractional shares will be issued in connection with the Reverse Stock Split. Stockholders otherwise entitled to a fractional share will instead receive cash, without interest, based on the closing price of the common stock on the NYSE on the trading day immediately preceding the date on which the Effective Time occurs, as adjusted for the Reverse Stock Split. The Reverse Stock Split will apply to all of Ready Capital’s authorized and outstanding shares of common stock uniformly and will not affect any record holder’s percentage ownership interest, except for de minimis changes as a result of the elimination of fractional shares. Stockholders of record will receive information from Computershare Trust Company, N.A., Ready Capital’s transfer agent, regarding their stock ownership following the Reverse Stock Split and cash in lieu of fractional share payments, if applicable. Stockholders who hold their shares in brokerage accounts or "street name" are not required to take any action in connection with the Reverse Stock Split.

***About Ready Capital Corporation***


Ready Capital Corporation (NYSE: RC) is a multi-strategy real estate finance company that originates, acquires, finances and services lower-to-middle-market investor and owner occupied commercial real estate loans. The Company specializes in loans backed by commercial real estate, including agency multifamily, investor, construction, and bridge as well as U.S. Small Business Administration loans under its Section 7(a) program. Headquartered in New York, New York, the Company employs over 400 professionals nationwide.
